L136-144 selectedKeys useMemo and atMax derived flag preserved identically.

AbortController/setTimeout are available in the RN (Hermes) runtime.

L182-203 loading = loadingProp || asyncLoading, filteredOptions (async vs defaultFilter then selected-removed), and visibleOptions slice(maxVisibleOptions) memos preserved with identical dependency arrays.

L205-232 announce-count effect and reset-active-index effect preserved: same no-results / 1-result / {{count}} results branching via t(), same lastAnnouncedRef de-dupe, same activeIndex clamp logic. announce() now routes to the native AnnouncerRegion (AccessibilityInfo.announceForAccessibility).

L234-291 imperative helpers ported faithfully: addOption (atMax guard, dup-key guard, onChange([...value,opt]), clear text, reset active, refocus input), removeAt (bounds guard, splice, onChange, announce 'Removed {{label}}'), closeDropdown, handleInputChange (e.target.value -> onChangeText text; opens on type), handleInputFocus (disabled guard -> setOpen(true)).

L285-291 handleWrapperBlur (relatedTarget contains check) -> handleInputBlur: there is no DOM relatedTarget on native, so the suppressBlurRef flag (set by internal option/chip/chevron onPressIn) decides whether the blur closes the dropdown; otherwise closeDropdown() runs, giving the same focus-leaves-field-closes behaviour.

L293-377 handleKeyDown -> handleKeyPress over e.nativeEvent.key: ArrowDown/ArrowUp wrap navigation, Home/End jump, Escape close, Backspace-at-empty removes trailing chip, Tab commits-or-closes -- all preserved (preventDefault() drops away as native key events have no default to cancel). Enter (L333-339) is committed via onSubmitEditing/handleSubmit instead, the reliable RN single-line return event, avoiding a double-fire with onKeyPress. onKeyPress fires on hardware-keyboard targets (RN Windows/macOS); touch is primary elsewhere.
L379-389 document mousedown outside-close effect -> documented native-safe replacement (TextInput blur + explicit chevron toggle), since RN has no `document`.

L391-417 render prep preserved: activeOptionId concept becomes the per-row isActive highlight + optionId testID; the visible-label class + labelContent (label plus optional '(n/max)' muted suffix) become an AppText caption/secondary with a nested muted AppText.

L419-543 field render ported: outer relative wrapper (className ignored); hideLabel -> native VisuallyHidden as='label', else a visible caption label row; the flex-wrap field becomes a Pressable row (tap focuses input) with focus-within ring -> fieldFocused border, disabled opacity; leading icon kept; each selected value renders a rounded chip (accentSoft/borderAccent) with a truncating label and an x remove Pressable (aria-label 'Remove {{label}}', onMouseDown-preventDefault -> onPressIn suppressBlur); the role=combobox input becomes a TextInput wired to value/onChangeText/onFocus/onBlur/onKeyPress/onSubmitEditing with the same placeholder logic (placeholder when empty, 'Maximum reached' at max, editable={!disabled}); the trailing cluster holds the loading spinner (CSS spinner -> ActivityIndicator) and the chevron toggle Pressable (rotating ChevronDown -> ▾/▴ glyph) with identical open/close handlers and aria labels.
L544-546 visually-hidden status region preserved as native VisuallyHidden id={statusId} showing the loading string.

L547-614 listbox preserved: role=listbox/aria-multiselectable -> an absolutely-positioned (top:'100%') bordered panel with panel shadow and a maxHeight ScrollView (keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled' so option taps register without dismissing the keyboard); the empty (No results / Maximum reached) row, the loading row, the mapped option rows (active highlight, atMax disabled+dimmed, renderOption passthrough or default label, onMouseEnter -> onPressIn setActiveIndex, onClick -> addOption), and the '{{count}} more — refine search' overflow row are all reproduced. L615-617 closing JSX/braces handled; displayName added.

Native-safe contract honoured: no DOM, no lucide-react, no recharts/leaflet, no web UI components imported; React Native View/Pressable/TextInput/ScrollView/ActivityIndicator primitives, design tokens, AppText, and native a11y helpers used throughout. Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck, npm run lint -- --quiet, npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
